content: {"phoneNote":"The opening-hours section turns six rows of identical magenta bars into a tall wall that dominates the page out of proportion to its value.","desktopNote":"Hero sits in a wide empty band and the price list leaves the right half blank below the fold while hours again sprawl over a full screen.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Collapse opening hours into a compact Mon–Fri / Sat text table; the six-bar timeline wastes a full screen on both viewports.","Tighten desktop vertical rhythm: cut the dead space under the hero and after hours, and lay the price list in a balanced three-column grid instead of leaving the right half empty.","Make the hero link a proper button and bring the bouquet photo or a price teaser into the first screen so the desktop above-the-fold does more than show one picture and a headline."],"blockers":[]}
